title: What are clinical notes, why do we make them and how?

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”课程现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在 2022 年完成了该课程，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持方案，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四场小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正寻求成为一名心理学家，那么让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客在身边，你将走上“有抱负的心理学家”播客之路。

sentences.en: With Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听“有抱负的心理学家”播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for tuning in and I hope you'll find today's episode really useful as ever.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你的收听，希望你像往常一样觉得今天的节目非常有用。

sentences.en: Today, we are thinking about something which is going to be useful for you, probably regardless of what your current role is.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要讨论的内容对你来说应该很有用，无论你目前担任什么职位。

sentences.en: So it is clinical notes.
sentences.zh: 那就是临床记录。

sentences.en: We're talking about clinical notes.
sentences.zh: 我们正在讨论临床记录。

sentences.en: And whatever role you're doing, if you're working with people, it's likely that there's some element of note taking.
sentences.zh: 无论你从事什么角色，只要你与人打交道，很可能都会涉及某种形式的记录工作。

sentences.en: So in case you don't know what clinical notes are, I thought I'd give you a little bit of an overview of that to begin with.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你不知道什么是临床记录，我想先为你做一个简单的概述。

sentences.en: So when we are working with people, we have certain responsibilities and safeguarding actions that we have to take to keep people safe.
sentences.zh: 当我们与人合作时，我们有特定的责任和必须采取的保障措施，以确保人们的安全。

sentences.en: But also it's useful for us to be able to log and discuss what has happened in the contacts, especially if that involves risk.
sentences.zh: 但同时，能够记录和讨论接触中发生的事情对我们来说也很有用，特别是如果涉及风险的话。

sentences.en: And that's so that other members of the multidisciplinary team can see what's going on, if there's a crisis call, for example, or if there's other members of the team involved.
sentences.zh: 这样，多学科团队的其他成员就能了解情况，例如在发生危机电话或有其他团队成员参与时。

sentences.en: Or if, for example, you were to go off on sick leave, it would be useful to know what had been happening in your sessions.
sentences.zh: 或者，如果你因病休假，了解你的会谈中发生了什么也会很有用。

sentences.en: So the main function of clinical notes is similar to supervision is client safety and also your own protection for you to be sort of legally and professionally saying what has happened in a session.
sentences.zh: 因此，临床记录的主要功能与督导类似，即客户安全，以及为了你自己的保护，让你在法律和专业层面上说明会谈中发生了什么。

sentences.en: So how often do we need to be writing them?
sentences.zh: 那么我们需要多久写一次呢？

sentences.en: When do we write them?
sentences.zh: 我们什么时候写？

sentences.en: How do we write them?
sentences.zh: 我们怎么写？

sentences.en: Those are all of the questions we're going to be covering today.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我们今天要涵盖的问题。

sentences.en: So in answer to how and when we write them, it might well be that you need to follow the guidance laid out by whichever employer you're working for.
sentences.zh: 关于如何以及何时撰写，你很可能需要遵循你所任职的雇主制定的指导方针。

sentences.en: So, for example, I think when I was working in an NHS trust most recently, they asked you to get it done within 48 hours.
sentences.zh: 例如，我想我最近在国民医疗服务体系（NHS）信托机构工作时，他们要求在 48 小时内完成。

sentences.en: I think I often found and still find that I am more likely to get it done within the appropriate timeframes if I do it right after the session.
sentences.zh: 我经常发现，如果我在会谈结束后立即完成，我更有可能在适当的时间内完成。

sentences.en: So I'm very much still a fan of a 50 minute clinical hour and then I use the remaining 10 minutes to write my notes and get that done.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常推崇 50 分钟的临床小时，然后我用剩下的 10 分钟来写记录并完成它。

sentences.en: I find that if I push it or delay it or for some other reason need to dash out and do something else or get distracted or want a cup of tea,
sentences.zh: 我发现如果我拖延，或者因为其他原因需要匆忙去做别的事情，或者分心，或者想喝杯茶，

sentences.en: then, yeah, it's less likely to happen in that timely manner within that day.
sentences.zh: 那么，是的，在当天及时完成的可能性就变小了。

sentences.en: And of course, our memories are fallible.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们的记忆是不可靠的。

sentences.en: So I would say where possible and obviously where your job plan allows, it's useful to get it done between sessions.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在可能的情况下，当然是在你的工作计划允许的情况下，在会谈之间完成记录是很有用的。

sentences.en: And I guess thinking about how you write notes as well can be useful.
sentences.zh: 我想思考一下你写记录的方式也很有用。

sentences.en: So it might be that you've got a trust phone or a trust tablet and that you can scribble your notes down on that between sessions.
sentences.zh: 你可能有一个信托机构配发的手机或平板电脑，可以在会谈间隙在上面草拟记录。

sentences.en: It might be that you do paper notes still.
sentences.zh: 也可能你仍然使用纸质记录。

sentences.en: I know that some services still do that.
sentences.zh: 我知道有些服务机构还在这样做。

sentences.en: Or it might be that you have to report your notes by entering them into a specific system.
sentences.zh: 或者你可能必须通过输入特定的系统来报告你的记录。

sentences.en: In the past, I've used Epex, Care Notes and Rio.
sentences.zh: 过去，我使用过 Epex、Care Notes 和 Rio。

sentences.en: And, yeah, you can't always access all of those systems from remote things like phones.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，你并不总是能从手机等远程设备访问所有这些系统。

sentences.en: But it might be worth saying that you might be able to, if you've got secure encrypted devices, such as, you know, a phone that's been given to you by your trust,
sentences.zh: 但值得一提的是，如果你有安全的加密设备，例如信托机构给你的手机，

sentences.en: that you could use the note facility to write your notes in there so that you can access them later, so that you're using the time you do have in a timely way.
sentences.zh: 你可以在里面使用记录功能来写记录，这样你以后可以访问它们，从而有效地利用你拥有的时间。

sentences.en: So, yeah, don't do anything that's not trust compliant.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，不要做任何不符合信托机构规定的事情。

sentences.en: So if your trust doesn't allow you to do that, then don't do that.
sentences.zh: 如果你的信托机构不允许你这样做，那就不要做。

sentences.en: But I'm always thinking about ways that I can maximise the time that I'm doing so that I'm not repeating things or so that I'm using snippets of time that I've got.
sentences.zh: 但我一直在思考如何最大化我的时间，这样我就不会重复工作，或者利用我拥有的碎片时间。

sentences.en: So, yeah, have a look at your job.
sentences.zh: 所以，看看你的工作。

sentences.en: Have a look at your job plan and see what might make that work for you.
sentences.zh: 看看你的工作计划，看看什么能让你更高效。

sentences.en: We're going to be going through some top tips for what to include in your clinical notes and how to do it in a way that makes them robust and user-friendly, hopefully.
sentences.zh: 我们将介绍一些关于临床记录中应包含哪些内容的建议，以及如何以一种稳健且用户友好的方式来撰写它们。

sentences.en: You know, it's likely that in some cases no one will read them, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在某些情况下，很可能没有人会阅读它们。

sentences.en: So if you hold your own clinical responsibility, then, you know, maybe no one will read them unless they get called by a court or they get requested by the client themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你承担自己的临床责任，那么，也许没有人会读它们，除非它们被法院传唤或客户本人要求查看。

sentences.en: And then you'll have the fun of redacting anything that you can't share with the patient,
sentences.zh: 那时你就会享受到涂改任何不能与患者分享的内容的乐趣了，

sentences.en: which is where you go through with a big, thick black marker pen, anything that can't be shared.
sentences.zh: 也就是用一支粗大的黑色记号笔划掉任何不能分享的内容。

sentences.en: So, for example, if they've been in a group and you've mentioned the actions of another group member,
sentences.zh: 例如，如果他们参加了一个小组，而你提到了另一个小组成员的行为，

sentences.en: even if you don't mention the group member's name, you can't put that in because that relates to another client.
sentences.zh: 即使你不提那个小组成员的名字，你也不能把它写进去，因为那涉及另一个客户。

sentences.en: You've got to, like, scrub that out.
sentences.zh: 你必须把它涂掉。

sentences.en: So, yeah, redacting is very fun when you get a request for that, either from a court or from the client themselves.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，当你收到法院或客户本人的请求时，涂改是非常有趣的。

sentences.en: And you then have to look through years and years of notes that may not even be your own if the person has left the service.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须翻阅多年来的记录，如果那个人已经离开了服务机构，这些记录甚至可能不是你自己的。

sentences.en: So I hope you don't experience that, but you probably are likely to at some point in your career.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你不要经历这种情况，但你职业生涯中的某个时刻很可能会遇到。

sentences.en: So be aware of that term redacting because it might well crop up for you.
sentences.zh: 所以要注意“涂改”这个词，因为它很可能会出现在你的工作中。

sentences.en: So, yes, if you are a trainee listening to this, then it's likely that you don't hold clinical responsibility for your own client work yet.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你是一名正在听这个节目的实习生，那么你很可能还没有承担自己客户工作的临床责任。

sentences.en: That would usually, as far as I'm aware, that would be held by your clinical supervisor.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，这通常由你的临床督导承担。

sentences.en: And similarly, if you're doing forensic or health, that would still be held by the qualified psychologist above you.
sentences.zh: 同样，如果你从事法医或健康领域的工作，这仍然由你上级的合格心理学家承担。

sentences.en: So my first top tip is always speak to your supervisor.
sentences.zh: 所以我的第一个建议是：一定要和你的督导沟通。

sentences.en: So if you're an assistant psychologist, you also don't hold clinical responsibility.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名助理心理学家，你也不承担临床责任。

sentences.en: But if you're a qualified PWP, I believe that you would hold your own clinical responsibility.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是一名合格的心理健康从业者（PWP），我相信你会承担自己的临床责任。

sentences.en: So nobody would be needing necessarily to cross check your notes.
sentences.zh: 所以没有人一定需要交叉检查你的记录。

sentences.en: Whereas I have worked in services where my notes have needed to sort of be secondarily signed.
sentences.zh: 而我曾在一些服务机构工作，我的记录需要被二次签名。

sentences.en: So you will need to check in with your individual trust requirements and also what is safe and ethical practice for the role that you are in.
sentences.zh: 所以你需要核实你所在信托机构的个人要求，以及对于你所处的角色来说，什么是安全和合乎道德的做法。

sentences.en: Another reason that you need to speak to your supervisor is because all supervisors will have different standards and expectations
sentences.zh: 你需要与督导沟通的另一个原因是，所有督导对临床记录的撰写方式以及他们认为“足够好”的标准和期望都有所不同。

sentences.en: for the way that they like to see clinical notes written and what feels good enough for them.
sentences.zh: 即使我参考了我在培训期间的六个不同的实习岗位，它们都有非常不同、非常不同的氛围和期望。

sentences.en: So even if I reference my six different placements that I did on training, all of them had a very different, very different vibe to them and very different expectations.
sentences.zh: 所以对于第一个岗位来说是正确的，对于第六个岗位来说肯定是不正确的。

sentences.en: So what was right for number one most certainly wouldn't have been right for number six.
sentences.zh: 特别是第六个岗位是一个心理动力学实习。

sentences.en: So for number six specifically was a psychodynamic placement.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们相信非常详细的记录，并且除了案例构思外，还要保留所谓的“过程记录”。

sentences.en: And of course, they believe in very detailed notes and also keeping something called process notes too, as well as formulations.
sentences.zh: 所以临床记录的过程与我为成年人工作时非常不同。

sentences.en: So the process for clinical notes was very different than it was, for example, when I was working with adults.
sentences.zh: 同样，当我们与儿童工作时，我们可能需要做更详尽的记录，以确保我们坚持保障实践，

sentences.en: And similarly, when we're working with children, we might need to make even more thorough notes to be just, you know, ensuring that we're sticking to safeguarding practices
sentences.zh: 并报告任何可能导致风险的事情。

sentences.en: and reporting on anything that could potentially lead to a risk.
sentences.zh: 所以我的下一个建议是我在刚获得资格时才发现的。

sentences.en: And so one of my next top tips is something that I only discovered when I was newly qualified.
sentences.zh: 那就是如果你正在做出决定，或者在支持下做出了决定，那么你应该将其记录在案。

sentences.en: And that is if you are making a decision or if you have had support to make a decision, then you should record that in the notes.
sentences.zh: 而且你应该证明你是如何做出该决定的。

sentences.en: But you should also justify how you've come to that decision.
sentences.zh: 如果这是作为多学科团队会议或与督导讨论的一部分，你需要证明该决策过程的依据。

sentences.en: So if that's as part of a multidisciplinary team meeting or discussion with your supervisor, you need to be evidencing the rationale for that decision making process.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你只是写下决定是什么，那么你是如何得出这个结论的就会有些模糊。

sentences.en: Because if you just write what the decision is, then it's a bit ambiguous about how you got there.
sentences.zh: 这有点像你在学校做数学题一样。

sentences.en: But it's a bit like in maths when you were doing maths at school.
sentences.zh: 如果你展示了你的计算过程，那么在法庭上，如果你需要证明你的理由，就会更清晰。

sentences.en: If you show your workings, then it's clearer in a court of law should you need to justify what you're justifying.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你被要求这样做，一定要能够支持你建议某事的原因。

sentences.en: So always be able to back up why you're suggesting something if you are asked to do it.
sentences.zh: 但我有时想，如果我被传唤到法庭，法官让我证明某事，除非它被写下来，否则我做不到。

sentences.en: But I sometimes think if I was called to a court and the judge asked me to justify something, unless it's written down, I can't.
sentences.zh: 我不能只是说，嗯，我把它记在心里了，因为那在法律上是不稳健的。

sentences.en: I can't just say, well, I was holding that in mind because that's not legally robuSt.
sentences.zh: 所以任何与风险和决策相关的内容都需要写在你的记录中。

sentences.en: So anything related to risk and decision making needs to be in your notes.
sentences.zh: 让我们在这里休息一下，然后我会回来分享我的下一个建议。

sentences.en: So let's take a brief break here and then I'll be back along with my next top tips.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 感谢你的坚持。

sentences.en: Thank you for sticking with me.
sentences.zh: 希望你喜欢这段插曲。

sentences.en: I hope you love the jingle.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我现在的临床记录做法是记录会谈次数。

sentences.en: So, yes, what I do with my clinical notes these days is that I will document the session number.
sentences.zh: 这可能还包括计划的会谈总数。

sentences.en: And that might well include of how many planned sessions as well.
sentences.zh: 例如，可能是 20 次中的第 8 次。

sentences.en: So it might be eight of 20, for example.
sentences.zh: 一旦你不知道会有多少次会谈，我只会写下这是第几次会谈，当然还有是否出席。

sentences.en: Once you don't know how many sessions are going to be, I would just write what the session number was and obviously whether it was attended or not.
sentences.zh: 此外，我会记录是否准时出席，如果没有，原因是什么。

sentences.en: Also, I would document whether it was attended on time and if not, what the reasons for that were.
sentences.zh: 可能是因为我自己的缺席或迟到。

sentences.en: It might have been my own absence, my own leaveness.
sentences.zh: 但是的，这种情况在私人执业中发生得不多。

sentences.en: But yes, it doesn't happen so much in private practice.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为从来没有发生过。

sentences.en: I don't think it's happened ever, actually.
sentences.zh: 但当然，当我在 NHS 服务机构或其他受雇服务机构时，有时是我让客户等待，这是我的责任。

sentences.en: But certainly when I was in NHS services or other employed services, sometimes it was my responsibility that I kept a client waiting.
sentences.zh: 所以我通常会过一遍要点，但不是详尽无遗的。

sentences.en: So I would kind of go through the main points, but not in an exhaustive fashion.
sentences.zh: 所以涵盖的要点，如果其中有任何相关的讨论点，我会把它们放在类似要点的部分中。

sentences.en: So the main points covered and if there were any pertinent discussion points within that, I would put those in almost as a bullet point kind of section.
sentences.zh: 比如我们讨论了某某某，你知道，就是那种东西。

sentences.en: So we discussed yada, yada, yada, you know, that sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 但它不是详尽的。

sentences.en: But it was not it's not exhaustive.
sentences.zh: 我目前不是以心理动力学的方式工作，所以它不是我能记住的关于会谈的一切。

sentences.en: I do not work in a psychodynamic way currently, so it's not everything I can remember about a session.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们需要确保其中包含任何与风险或保障相关的内容。

sentences.en: Of course, we need to make sure that we've got any elements in there that are related to risk or safeguarding.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你正在合作的客户或他们生活中直接负责的人有正在进行的保障案件，

sentences.en: So if there's an open safeguarding case going on for the client that you're working with or someone immediately in their life that they are kind of responsible for,
sentences.zh: 那么我们需要进行讨论并重新审视它，并记录与保障相关的任何变化或任何更新。

sentences.en: then we need to be having that discussion and revisiting that and documenting any changes with relation to safeguarding or any updates in there.
sentences.zh: 同样，如果有任何风险因素和任何冒险行为，

sentences.en: And similarly, if there's any elements of risk and any elements of sort of risk taking,
sentences.zh: 那么你需要证明这一点，并且你需要证明是否有管理该风险的计划，

sentences.en: then you need to be evidencing that and you need to be evidencing if there's a plan to manage that risk,
sentences.zh: 这可能与你与他们共同制定的护理计划或风险计划，或者与团队其他成员或精神科医生共同制定的计划有关。

sentences.en: which might well link back to any care plan or risk plan that's been done either with you in conjunction with you or with other members of the team or psychiatry.
sentences.zh: 我还会涵盖任何商定的行动点。

sentences.en: I will also cover any agreed action points.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有家庭作业或需要自己完成的工作，或者客户说他们会努力去做的事情，

sentences.en: So if there's homework or own work to be done or things that the client said they were going to strive to do,
sentences.zh: 那么它们会被记录下来，以便在下次会谈前我需要回顾时，

sentences.en: then they will be they will be noted down so that if and when I need to review those before seeing the client for the next session,
sentences.zh: 我能迅速掌握我们正在努力的目标以及我们商定的内容。

sentences.en: I'm quickly up to speed with with what we're what we're striving for, what we're aiming for and what we'd agreed.
sentences.zh: 这不一定是为了检查他们，而是为了思考，我想知道你做得怎么样，感觉如何？

sentences.en: And it's not necessarily as a way of, you know, checking up on them, but it's thinking about, you know, I wonder how how you got on with that and what's that been like for you?
sentences.zh: 自上次见面以来，有什么新的或不同的事情吗？

sentences.en: And is there anything, you know, new or different since we met last time?
sentences.zh: 这可以成为探索该领域的一种非常好的方式，而不会让人们觉得他们被监视了。

sentences.en: That can be a really nice way of exploring that area without making people feel like they're being checked up on.
sentences.zh: 然后我会写下下次会谈的日期，基本就是这样。

sentences.en: And then I would write the next session date and that's pretty much it.
sentences.zh: 所以它们不会特别长。

sentences.en: So they're not super long.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，它们是 50 分钟的会谈。

sentences.en: Like I said, they're 50 minute sessions.
sentences.zh: 如果我做了 EMDR（眼动脱敏再加工），那么现在会有单独的无纸化文书工作，因为我一直在使用我非常喜欢的 Remarkable 2 平板电脑。

sentences.en: And if there's EMDR that I've done, then there will be separate paper free paperwork now because I've been using the Remarkable 2 tablet that I really like.
sentences.zh: 所以我稍后会谈谈那个。

sentences.en: So I will talk about that in a moment.
sentences.zh: 但是的，那里有额外的文书工作。

sentences.en: But yeah, there's extra paperwork there.
sentences.zh: 所以我也要报告说已经制作了单独的 EMDR 文书，并将添加到档案中。

sentences.en: So I would also report that separate EMDR paperwork has been made and will be added to the file.
sentences.zh: 让我们来思考一下我拥有的这个 Remarkable 平板电脑。

sentences.en: So let's have a little think about this Remarkable tablet that I've got.
sentences.zh: 我用它来规划今天的播客节目。

sentences.en: So I've used it to plan today's podcast episode.
sentences.zh: 你可能没听说过无纸化平板电脑。

sentences.en: You might not have heard of a paper free tablet.
sentences.zh: 它叫 Remarkable 2。

sentences.en: So it's called it's called a Remarkable 2.
sentences.zh: 它附带了……其实，我不认为它附带了那个。

sentences.en: And it comes with actually, I don't think it does come with it.
sentences.zh: 我想你必须单独购买。

sentences.en: I think you have to buy it separately.
sentences.zh: 所以我单独买了这支笔，它的末端有一个不错的小橡皮擦，你可以擦掉东西。

sentences.en: So I bought this pen separately and it's got a nice little rubber on the end that you can rub stuff out.
sentences.zh: 但我喜欢它的一点是，例如，昨天我第一次在上面做了督导记录。

sentences.en: But what I like about it is that, so for example, for the first time yesterday, I made supervision notes on it.
sentences.zh: 然后我可以快速地通过电子邮件将它们作为 PDF 发送，或者通过几次点击按钮发送给自己。

sentences.en: And then I can quickly send those as a PDF via email or through a few clicks of the button to send it to myself.
sentences.zh: 然后我可以直接将其上传到客户的临床记录中，并备注已添加督导记录。

sentences.en: And then I can just upload that to the client's clinical notes and make a note that the supervision notes have been have been added.
sentences.zh: 所以，同样，你需要检查什么是符合信托机构规定的。

sentences.en: So, again, you need to check what was trust compliant.
sentences.zh: 但我一直在思考如何最大化我拥有的时间。

sentences.en: But I'm always thinking about how to maximise the time that I've got.
sentences.zh: 所以我发现我喜欢督导。

sentences.en: So I found that I like supervision.
sentences.zh: 我享受那个过程。

sentences.en: I enjoy that process.
sentences.zh: 但之后必须为此写单独的记录，特别是当我现在在私人执业时，我没有得到那段时间的报酬，感觉有点沮丧。

sentences.en: But then having to write separate notes for it afterwards, especially when I'm now in private practice, I don't get paid for that time, just felt a bit frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这就是我非常喜欢这个无纸化平板电脑的原因，因为一切都在会谈中完成。

sentences.en: So that's where I'm really liking this paper free tablet, because everything happens within the session.
sentences.zh: 然后它会自动保存。

sentences.en: And then it just saves automatically.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这非常方便。

sentences.en: And then I can just do it with a quick few clicks and save.
sentences.zh: 然后我只需点几下鼠标就能保存了。

sentences.en: So if you think that might work for you, then you could well discuss that with your supervisor or your manager.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你觉得这方法适合你，不妨和你的主管或经理讨论一下。

sentences.en: I did try initially to try and get on board with that happening with an iPad, but I could not get it to do what I wanted to do and for it to remain as functional.
sentences.zh: 起初我确实尝试过用 iPad 来实现这些功能，但我无法让它达到我想要的效果，也无法保持同样的实用性。

sentences.en: So what I like about the Remarkable is that I can go back into the notes, they can stay handwritten, or I can have little bits appear in typed text to help it stand out more.
sentences.zh: Remarkable 平板最让我喜欢的一点是，我可以随时回到笔记中，既可以保留手写内容，也可以插入一些打印文本，让重点更突出。

sentences.en: I can draw my family trees on there, which I really like to do.
sentences.zh: 我可以在上面画家族树，我真的很喜欢这样做。

sentences.en: So, yeah, when I was buying my Remarkable, I couldn't find any discount codes.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我买 Remarkable 的时候，没能找到任何折扣码。

sentences.en: And that was frustrating to me.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到很沮丧。

sentences.en: But I have got a $40 off code if you do want to try it out.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想尝试一下，我这里有一个 40 美元的优惠码。

sentences.en: And there's 100 day quibble free returns as well.
sentences.zh: 而且还有 100 天无理由退货服务。

sentences.en: So if that is something you think might help you in terms of your organisation,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这能对你的整理工作有所帮助，

sentences.en: because you can save everything in separate folders and it's all can be password protected and all of that jazz.
sentences.zh: 因为你可以把所有东西分门别类地存放在文件夹里，还能设置密码保护等等，非常方便。

sentences.en: So, yes, if you think that's something that would be useful, then do think about getting yourself a tablet.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果你觉得这东西有用，不妨考虑给自己买个平板。

sentences.en: And there will be details in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 详细信息会在节目备注里提供。

sentences.en: Or you can send me a DM if you want that coupon code to get $40 off, which I would have loved because I could not find any coupon codes anywhere when I was doing it.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你想要那个 40 美元的优惠码，也可以直接私信我。我当时买的时候到处都找不到优惠码，如果那时候有的话我一定会很开心。

sentences.en: So I would say it's transformed my practice and I'm going to look at whether I can implement it into my clinical notes with clients.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为它彻底改变了我的工作方式，我打算看看能否把它应用到我的临床客户记录中。

sentences.en: The only difficulty being is I don't currently write clinical notes in sessions because I find it sometimes takes away something about what I'm doing with the client.
sentences.zh: 唯一的困难是，我目前在咨询过程中不写临床记录，因为我觉得这有时会分散我对客户的注意力。

sentences.en: So I'd need to think quite carefully about the way that I do that, especially as I'm being paid for that time by the client.
sentences.zh: 所以我需要仔细考虑一下该怎么做，尤其是因为客户为这段时间支付了费用。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I want to think about how I can do that in a way that suits my needs and doesn't take from the client and their session.
sentences.zh: 但确实，我想思考一下如何以一种既满足我需求，又不影响客户及其咨询体验的方式来完成记录。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I would love any thoughts you've got about how you do your clinical notes and whether you found this episode useful, whether it's raised any thoughts for you, really,
sentences.zh: 所以，我很想听听你对临床记录的看法，以及你是否觉得这期节目有用，或者它是否引发了你的一些思考，

sentences.en: whether you are the sort of person that likes to write really long notes, whether you're all about the brevity, you know, because we're all individually different.
sentences.zh: 无论你是喜欢写长篇大论的人，还是追求简洁的人，毕竟我们每个人都是不同的。

sentences.en: But it might be that you're very much led by what your current supervisor's requirements are.
sentences.zh: 但也可能你很大程度上受限于当前主管的要求。

sentences.en: What I found is, especially once qualified, you can take the bits from certain jobs or placements that you do like and anything that doesn't work for you doesn't sit.
sentences.zh: 我发现，尤其是在获得资格认证后，你可以从你喜欢的工作或实习中汲取经验，而那些不适合你的东西，

sentences.en: You can leave behind when you leave.
sentences.zh: 当你离开时就可以抛之脑后。

sentences.en: And then as long as you're following the guidance of any new supervisor, until you're qualified, you can pretty much do what you like, what works for you.
sentences.zh: 只要你遵循新主管的指导，在获得资格之前，你几乎可以做任何你喜欢、且对你有效的事情。

sentences.en: Because you're allowed to develop your own personal style and flair as well.
sentences.zh: 因为你也被允许发展出自己的个人风格和特色。

sentences.en: So if you would welcome more advice and guidance about so many different topics, we've also got stuff coming up in the membership about logical and deductive reasoning,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你希望在更多不同主题上获得建议和指导，我们在会员区也即将推出关于逻辑和演绎推理的内容，

sentences.en: which I know is a big part of some D-Clim-Sci testing processes.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是某些临床心理学博士（D-Clim-Sci）测试过程中的重要部分。

sentences.en: So we've got a session happening on that to help develop confidence.
sentences.zh: 所以我们安排了一场相关课程来帮助大家建立信心。

sentences.en: So by the time you listen to this, it will have happened,
sentences.zh: 当你听到这段话时，课程应该已经结束了，

sentences.en: but you'd be able to access that on replay if that is something that you feel would be useful for you to develop your confidence and competence in that area.
sentences.zh: 但如果你觉得这有助于提升你在该领域的信心和能力，你仍然可以观看回放。

sentences.en: We've also got loads of other stuff in there.
sentences.zh: 我们里面还有很多其他内容。

sentences.en: We've got seven or eight months worth of CBT teaching that you can work through.
sentences.zh: 我们有七八个月的 CBT（认知行为疗法）教学内容供你学习。

sentences.en: We've got loads of stuff on reflective practice.
sentences.zh: 我们还有大量关于反思性实践的内容。

sentences.en: It's just a good place to hang out.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的交流场所。

sentences.en: It's a really, really nice supportive group of people.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常、非常友善且互相支持的群体。

sentences.en: So do check out the Aspiring Psychologist Membership, which you can join for £30 a month, which also gets you access to the back catalogue.
sentences.zh: 所以一定要看看“有抱负的心理学家会员计划”（Aspiring Psychologist Membership），每月只需 30 英镑，还能让你访问往期所有内容。

sentences.en: And you can leave whenever time suits you.
sentences.zh: 而且你可以随时退出。

sentences.en: For more information on that, do check out the show notes or check my socials.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请查看节目备注或关注我的社交媒体。

sentences.en: And yeah, it will be available via my bio links.
sentences.zh: 是的，相关信息可以通过我个人主页的链接找到。

sentences.en: There's information about the membership.
sentences.zh: 那里有关于会员计划的信息。

sentences.en: Do also please come along and join the free group on Facebook, which is the Aspiring Psychologist Community, brackets free group.
sentences.zh: 也请一定要加入我们在 Facebook 上的免费群组，即“有抱负的心理学家社区”（Aspiring Psychologist Community，括号内为免费群组）。

sentences.en: I think it says my name.
sentences.zh: 我想上面写着我的名字。

sentences.en: It's Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 是 Marianne Trent 博士。

sentences.en: Or come and connect with me on all of my social channels.
sentences.zh: 或者在我的所有社交频道上与我联系。

sentences.en: I am now Dr. Marianne Trent, and I love helping you celebrate your wins and hearing what you think to the content that I produce.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我乐于帮助你们庆祝自己的成就，也喜欢听听你们对我制作的内容有何看法。

sentences.en: So again, thank you so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 再次非常感谢大家的收听。

sentences.en: Thank you for being part of my world and wishing you a lovely day, whatever you're up to.
sentences.zh: 感谢你们成为我世界的一部分，祝你们无论在做什么，都能拥有美好的一天。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚取除了出卖时间以外的收入，会怎样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要告诉大家。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One to Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”（One to Many）项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员计划和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在 2022 年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的成长之路。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的推荐链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的额外专属支持包，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组策划会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
